notes.title: Patch: Shift Happens v1.1 and 20% off!
notes.notes:
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/patch_v1.1_lobby_hats/steam_capsulemain.png

Post Release Patch v1.1 and 20% discount!
Almost four months have passed now and we have been quiet for a long time since the release of Shift Happens v1.0. To celebrate our first patch the game will be on discount for 20% for a week! :)
We were working on different other projects (contract work) but collected all the feedback in the forums and tried to squeeze in as much extra time as we could to improve Shift Happens.

We also felt that the hat feature we implemented was too hidden in the game to get recognized and so we changed it. Now you can simply select any hat in the lobby. You might also recognize some of your favourite youtubers amongst them:

http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/patch_v1.1_lobby_hats/hats.gif

http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/patch_v1.1_lobby_hats/hats2.gif

We also fixed a few issues, mostly online multiplayer things:

 Added "FXAA" Option for Anti-Aliasing in settings 
 Fixed "Don't be mad at your friend" timechallenge achievement.You will need to replay (and pass) any multiplayer timechallenge to finally unlock this achievement.      
 Fixed an input menu bug with custom settings
 Fixed graphic issues in credits scene
 Network: Improved sync in general  
 Network: Fixed chain coin async      
 Network: Fixed size async
 Network: Fixed endless loading screen      
 Network: Fixed dead players snapping      
 Network: Fixed holodeck effect playing for client on restarted timetrials      
 Network: Fixed cutscene async in winroom


Huge thanks to everyone that bought the game, wrote a review or simply liked us on our social media channels. We appreciate it very much.

Cheers,

Team of Klonk

PS: Want to contact us? Try our Facebook or Twitter Pages:

Shift Happens:
Facebook Shift Happens
Twitter Shift Happens

Our company Klonk:
Facebook Klonk Games
Twitter Klonk Games

notes.title: Release: February 22nd! Finally making Shift Happen!
notes.notes:
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/announcement_full_release_date/header_img.png
Release!
I can't believe I am actually writing these words but we have a final release date for Shift Happens:
February 22nd, which is roughly one week after Valentines Day. 

We couldn't be happier about it! Therefore I'd like to point out again that we are very grateful for everyone that supported us by either buying the game in Early Access, giving us feedback, writing a review or simply telling us that they like it. 
Considering that Shift Happens most certainly wasn't an ideal type of game for an Early Access title (linear playthrough, depending on lots of content, very co-op), we still think it was good to put it out there and have the players take a look. We also learned a lot by going through the process and will take that experience into consideration for future projects.
We hope you are as excited as we are and are looking forward to the 22nd.

Livestream today
We will also have a livestream @ CET 7pm with Nora, our character artist and Simon our Shader/FX and 3D Art guy today on twitch creating some new hats for the game.

Cheers,

Team of Klonk

notes.title: Last patch before release!
notes.notes:
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/last_patch_before_release/header_img.png
Happy new years!
Hey gals and boys! First off, a late happy new years to you all. All Klonkers have had their hard-earned vacations over christmas and new years and we are back in 2017 with fresh energy.
We are so very happy to tell you guys, that this will be the last patch before our final release. Everybody has been busy working on the game and finishing the last stage, the grotto!
Although the release date is still not exactly set in stone, we can definitely say it will be soon and launched for Steam, XBOX and PS4 aswell!

15% off, should I get the game now or wait?
For everybody that has had the game on the wishlist for a while now and always waited for the full release, I'd like to tell you that we will raise the price for the full launch to 14,99$. This means, you should definitely get it now since it will be a little bit more expensive when fully released. And you'll get the same version anyways.


As a reminder, the game will fully feature the following content:

 Local and Online Co-op
 32 singleplayer level incl. 4 unlockable bonuslevel
 41 multiplayer  level incl. 4 unlockable bonuslevel
 Story cutscenes
 unlockable hats via a code
 31 unlockable achievements
 6 Trading Cards


We also have a few small fixes for you :)

Fixes
General:

 Fixed a bug where the "reset controls"-message always appeared for no reason
 Fixed a bug that was caused when you lifted a crate over an edge
 Added a new picture in the input menu for PS4 controllers


Netcode:

 Fixed a bug where Bismo & Plom stayed inactive in the main menu when leaving an online session


We also updated the whole Store Page! 
Enjoy everybody! 

All the best,
Team of Klonk

notes.title: A long overdue update! Release Info and more
notes.notes:
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/announcement_overdue_update/header_img.png
Hey girls and boy! First off, I owe you all an apology:
It has been so very quiet around the forums and the launch of Shift Happens and I am sorry for that!
For everyone that was wondering why the game still hasn't launched yet, I will try to clarify and give an insight into what's happening @Klonk Games lately.
Although we thought the launch would be this july we had to delay it to an - even for us - unknown date. 
This was back in August, pre-gamescom and now it is November already. During this time a lot has happened for us, especially when it comes to marketing the game.

Timing is everything
That said, our initial plan was to release Shift Happens on steam this july together with the XBOX One version simultaneously.
Now, speaking from a marketing point of view as a small developer, everybody you talk to regarding this issue will tell you that timing your launch means "everything". Simply said, your release date will have a big impact on how your game will eventually sell. Obviously there's a lot more to it than just the release date but it plays an important role anyways. Most importantly, releasing an indie game in Q4 (sept to december) is always a higher risk because around this time all the bigger companies are announcing and releasing their triple A titles. So chances are very low for your game to get picked up by press and therefore won’t get much attention or any at all. Of course, there might be exceptions but exceptions prove the rule, right?

With this in mind, we had lots of discussions and came to the conclusion that, since we didn't manage to get everything perfectly done for a launch in early august, we would have to delay the release even further. 

Why no patches/updates
Now you might obviously ask: "Well, if you had to delay the launch, why hasn't there been an update/patch on steam?"
One reason is staying alive. As mentioned a lot of times, we are constantly doing contract works to make ends meet and still be able to develop Shift Happens.
The other reason for this is that we had to switch yet again to a newer version of the engine we use, which is Unity 3D. From a game dev's point of view, having to switch to a newer version of your engine sometimes can mean re-doing a whole lot of work. In our case it meant playtesting (looking for old/new bugs) and lightbaking EVERYTHING again. Lightbaking is a procedure that takes a long time and a lot effort. Very simply put, lightbaking takes real time lighting from a scene and "bakes" it onto your objects so they look illuminated. This process comes with a lot of issues/bugs itself which means setting it up with parameters that work is a walk on a tightrope itself. Now having to re-do this with an updated lightbaking process means re-setting every parameter again to ensure the game looks still like before the engine update. That alone took us 2 months. Which brings me to my last point:

This patch/update
We have currently finalized light baking processes and bugs that came with the update of Unity. This patch is a bigger one due to the re-done lightmaps and will include a few bugfixes as well, but mostly minor things.

Full Release date and content
With all that explained, we are aiming for a simlaunch for early 2017 Q1 where we will launch on every platform Steam, XBOX One and PS4.
The full release will still feature the current game including:

the 4th and last stage of the game, The Grotto! (10+1 Bonuslevel in multiplayer and 7+1 bonuslevel in singleplayer) 
The story cutscenes, explaining Bismo and Plom's connection 
Bug fixes.


I'd also like to encourage everyone to give feedback or ask questions if there are any!

Other than that I will make sure to update you more consistently on what is happening or if anything has changed for the release of the game. Believe me when I say there's nothing more that we want than to finally release our baby "Shift Happens”

Cheers,

Team of Klonk

notes.title: Finally. Hats! Pre-Gamescom Update.
notes.notes:
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/announcement_hat_update_gc2016/header_img.png
Hello everybody!

Gamescom 2016 is almost here and we got a small nifty update for you:
You can now unlock hat's for Bismo and Plom. 

Right now you can simply unlock them in the Profiles tab under Settings in the Main Menu.
Here's is how it works:
[olist]
 In the main menu, go to "settings" and select the "profile" tab. 
 In the profile tab there are two text fields for each character "Bismo" and "Plom". 
 Put in a code in one (or both) of the text fields and hit "Enter" or just click out of the field to activate the code. 
 A green checkmark indicates if your code was accepted. A red "!" tells you that it was wrong.
 If everything was accepted you can now start the game and your characters will wear the hats! If you don't want them to wear their hats anymore, just go to the profile tab again and hit the "clear" button.
[/olist]
Note: Right now you can unlock only one of the following codes:

 Viking, 
 Crown, 
 Sombrero and 
 Shark

http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/announcement_hat_update_gc2016/hats.gif

We will slowly be adding more and more hats to the game. Not all hats will always be wearable by both characters!
Got a funny idea for a hat? Let us know, we might consider integrating it!

If you happen to be at Gamescom, stop by our booth at the Indie Arena Booth in Hall 10.1. You can grab some special hat codes there!

We hope you like the hats.
Have fun,

Your Team of Klonk!

notes.title: Build 160406 - Bugfixes, Sound & Improvements!
notes.notes:
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/bugfixes_sound_&_improvements_01/header_img.png

Hello everybody,

Long time no hear, sorry for that. I can just say we are still working very hard on the game and since we are a small team that really sweats blood and tears to make a living out of game dev, we also have to do other stuff (contract work) in order to stay alive financially.That said, we come with a an update that brings you great fixes and a little bit of polish.

Contentwise, it is important to note that the full content (the last stage "grotto" and cutscenes with story) will be released with the full release.
Unfortunately we can't tell you when exactly the full release will be but it might take around 1-3 months.

Anyways, this update brings a lot of small fixes and hopefully bigger ones for those of you that had issues playing the game.
So lets start of with whats new:

POLISH & SOUND

 Added timerun clocks and a message when you first unlock a timerun by completing a level
 The main and pause menu got a visual update and now have different colored buttons depending on the current stage 
 A lot of sounds got added including voice overs for Bismo and Plom
 The winscreen got music jingles and cool sound effects
 All levels now got (updated) ambience sounds


http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/bugfixes_sound_&_improvements_01/menu_update.png

http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/bugfixes_sound_&_improvements_01/timerun.gif

FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS

Netcode:

 Fixed bonus object sometimes not being sync
 Fixed some asyncs with lifting/dropping. Also made lifting look smoother on client
 Synced up lives more
 Added waiting screen when waiting for connected partner to load a level
 Fixed worldmap sometimes not being sync
 Fixed pushing/pulling with two players being async
 Fixed pushing/pulling sometimes blocking levers


General:

 Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented the player from getting lifted
 Show current amount of lives more clearly at start of level
 Fixed helping planes show false buttons after disconnect a joystick
 Hide heart dispenser during holodeck cutscene
 Improved scale sound behaviour
 Added a clock to start timeruns
 Better walk over a toppling poles
 Fixed a shift-bug when shifting simultaneously which lead to an invisible character model
 Character are no longer able to lift lasercrate because its too dangerous
 Fixed achievement progress being wrong
 Fixed "Skip" not getting localized correctly
 Many small sound improvements
 Always collect coins you touched when entering a goal
 Fixed fetch-sound not stopping when dying
 Fixed taunt-sound not stopping in checkpoint
 Fixed timer circle display being offset


Menu:

 Winroom: No longer able to open menu while the next level
 Winroom: Show info display again after closing the worldmap
 Winroom: Sometime showed only 74 coins instead of the collected 75
 Winroom: Other level info window if no timerun was active
 Input Menu: Fixed sometimes getting stuck in key change mode
 Worldmap: New message for unlocking a bonuslevel
 Worldmap: New message for unlocking the first time challenge
 Removed level info from test areas because it didn't contain any info at all
 Close message windows with mouse clicks
 Fixed bonus levels not displaying their progress
 Fixed pause menu disappearing a bit too early when closing
 New menu colors
 Improved blending between worldmap and other menus


So far so good, have fun and enjoy,

Team of Klonk

notes.title: Build 151222 - Content Update #5
notes.notes:
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/05_content_update_18_12_2015/header_img.png

Christmas is going to be earlier than expected... at least for Bismo and Plom!
First of all, Team Klonk wishes everyone of you Merry Shift-Mass and a Happy New Year!
 
The past few weeks/month have been very stressfull and busy for us. To be honest, we have been whippin' our asses off to get everything done and create a new content update for the holidays...
and we really did it! 
We are very happy to finally be able to have some vacation and bring you some brand new content for the holidays to play with your partner, friend, parents, spouse, husband, dog and cat!

The biggest change with this update is the worldmap! With the worldmap you finally can see your level progress, collect stars and unlock bonuslevels. We even added time stars for each level!

Due to the rather light feedback on the game in general escpecially on our "challenge levels" we decided to remove them, since they were just some experimental levels.

Remember that you can always check out what's planned for the future of Shift Happens here!

CONTENT

 Added the Worldmap incl. cool names for each level!
 Added Winmachine in the Winroom for more fanciness!

notes.title: Update delayed. Merry Shiftmas anyways!
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

This time, short and sweet:

We won't make the update this week. Not because we didn't manage to do it, but rather because we had to make a decision.

To clarify:

If the next update would not just include the worldmap, but also a whole bunch of new content to play for you, we would've gone for it.
But the fact that we would've just pushed the worldmap with the update (which is still in a work-in-progress state meaning bugs 'n stuff), wouldn't have justified the amount of work we have to do in order to upload and create a new build version for the game.
Therefore we decided against it, and I hope you understand! It will make the game even better!

Other than that, we also wish you guys a happy delayed santas day (at least in germany we have that! yes, no krampus, just Saint Nicholas).

Also Nora, our animator has been busy polishing our cutscene together with Niko and Simon, our glorious Artists.
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/announcement_04_no_xmas_update/cutscene_crash.gif
Plom is rolling all the time.



We will also have a new winroom which has been done in collab of Robin and Elena and there'll be a new ingame UI including a time display.

http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/announcement_04_no_xmas_update/winmachine.png


http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/announcement_04_no_xmas_update/ui_ingame.png

We are trying to push out the next update as soon as possible, so stay tuned and Merry Shiftmas to you all!

Cheers
Team of Klonk

notes.title: Next Content Update and News- Worldmap, CaRtOonz and H2ODelirious!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
Long time no see (or hear rather).

As I already said in our last Content Update, we could not keep our 2-week-schedule for content updates.
That said, we will have a content patch next week though.
We are still re-lightbaking levels so this will take a while, even though we are now baking with a 32 cpu monster that doesn't really speed up the lightbaking process much (YES, as ridiculous as that sounds).

Anyways, we have been busy as hell and still a lot has to be done, fixed and improved. 
We will have a content update next week on wednesday, december 9th.
It will feature the worldmap where you can finally see your level progression including collected stars, bonus objects and other things.

http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/announcement_02_content_update/worldmap_lab_wip.png

Other than that,
As you might have noticed we have been included in the steam sale 30% off and we hope everyone that bought the game enjoys it and has fun with it!

We thank you everyone for the support, it means a lot and keeps us working.
If you like Shift Happens, and would like to support us even more it would be very nice if you left us a review of the game or gave us feedback on it!

Last but not least, for everyone that bought the game or came here because of H2ODelirious and CaRtOonz:
Right now you can't get their masks unfortunately but we are working on a hat-shop feature where you can unlock hats with earned stars.

http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/02_content_update_07_10_2015/youtubers.gif

I can't really promise if we will ever make it happen, but we would love to.

At this point I would like to give a shoutout to CaRtOonz and H2ODelirious for playing the game, having fun with it! We thank you very much and appreciate it. We feel honored and it's a blast to watch you guys play the game.

If you like funny and entertaining Let's Plays make sure to subscribe to their channels here:

CaRtOonz
H2ODelirious

Otherwise, here's the latest episode of them playing Shift Happens:

H2O and CaRtOonz make shift happen

Cheers,

Team Klonk

notes.title: Build 151104 - Content Update #4
notes.notes:
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/04_content_update_04_11_2015/header_img.png
(one of our artists is missing, therefore I had to improvise with the header image)

Hi everybody! Content Update Number 4 is here with good and not so good news.

First off the good news:

Yet again, it's only been two weeks since our last Content Update and we tried to push as much as possible.

We added another two bonus levels (canyon single- and multiplayer WIP) to the game and the second ones were made beautiful by our art department.
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/04_content_update_04_11_2015/added_bonus_levels.png

The not so good news is, that we have to switch to the latest version of our engine Unity due to porting problems for XBOX One (yes, the game will one day also be on Xbox One, yay) BUT
this means that we will have to lightbake all of our levels again!
Lightbaking is a really time intensive process therefore we will not be able to keep up our 2-week-update-schedule.
That said I can't exactly tell you when the next update will be, but I can assure you we are still working on everything and I will at least try to keep you up-to-date via announcements.

We also disabled the halloween feature a little bit earlier than the 7th because of some tech-difficulties. We still hope you had a little fun with it!
So let's go with today's Update!

CONTENT
Our art and level design gang have been working on... wait for it... levels (what a surprise!):

Singleplayer:
 
 Following levels now have graphics: Forest bonus level, Canyon1-3 
 New Work in Progress Levels: Canyon4-6, Canyon Bonus level

http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/04_content_update_04_11_2015/added_singleplayer_levels.png

Multiplayer:

 Following levels now have graphics: Forest bonus level, Canyon9 
 New Work in Progress Levels: Canyon Bonus Level

http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/04_content_update_04_11_2015/added_multiplayer_levels.png

FIXES
Coders coded code. A lot. 
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/04_content_update_04_11_2015/coders.gif

General:


 Fixed Button misplacement
 Fixed a bug where characters sometimes were the same size at the start of a level (except for the 2 first multiplayer levels) 
 Fixed a missing material for the "loading" icon in the mode selection (it was just pink)


Online Multiplayer:

 Fixed other Player sometimes lookin in the wrong direction



Remember that you can always check out what's planned for the future of Shift Happens here!

As always, feedback is highly appreciated! Hope you feel the game is getting better :)
Cheers!

notes.title: BUILD 150923 - Content update and fixes!
notes.notes:
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/01_content_update_23_09_2015/header_img.png

First of all, a big thanks to all of you that bought the game, had fun and gave their feedback!

It means a lot to us because it keeps us going and work hard for you guys to improve the game.
Every kind word, review and screenshot of the game empowers us as developers to bring you an even better experience.

So here we go: Our first big content update! 

A lot of shift work has been done to deliver you the best shift possible!


Art Content
The devil lies in the details, also in Shift Happens.

Improvments:

 Compressed lightmaps: This basically means the game is now just 3,7gb instead of ~9gb big. This is a big win :D
 Coins now fly in pretty curves when collected (yay!) http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/01_content_update_23_09_2015/coin_trails.gif
 Added more splash effects for water-collision, because we all like splash.http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/01_content_update_23_09_2015/water_splasher.gif


Our artists were also very busy and updated all the stylish-editor levels with a fresh look.
The level designers also got some work done and theres a bunch of new editor levels to try out for you!

Singleplayer:

 following levels now have grahpics: forest01, forest02
 new Levels in editor-look for testing: forest03, forest04 (work in progress!)


1p_forest01
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/01_content_update_23_09_2015/1p_forest01.jpg


1p_forest02
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/01_content_update_23_09_2015/1p_forest02.jpg


Multiplayer:

 following levels now have grahpics: forest04, forest05 and canyon04, canyon05
 new Levels in editor-look for testing: forest06, forest07 and canyon06, canyon07 (work in progress!)


2p_forest04
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/01_content_update_23_09_2015/2p_forest04.jpg


2p_forest05
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/01_content_update_23_09_2015/2p_forest05.jpg


2p_canyon04
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/01_content_update_23_09_2015/2p_canyon04.jpg


2p_canyon05
http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/01_content_update_23_09_2015/2p_canyon05.jpg



FIXES

The code department did its best to squash all the bugs they could find. Some of them were really big.

Online Multiplayer:

 Improved synchronization for lifting crates and the small character
 Improved synchronization regarding interaction (using levers, toggle barriers, turning lasers on/off etc.)
 The bonus-object should now be synced between host and client (no more double bonus-object)
 Lives are now correctly displayed on the clients' side
 Coins, poles and all liftable object should now be more reliable in general
 Generally the online multiplayer should be more stable/better


Menu:

 Fixed some bugs in the mode-selection and network-menu
 Levelselection: challengelevels now show the correct amount of coins
 Controls: walk left/right is no longer switched in german



We hope you like the update and please leave us your feedback!
Other than that enjoy the game, have fun and bear with us: we are trying to fix every problem at a time :)
